selected_tasks: till dirt into farmland with hoe
selection_reasoning: This task is a single atomic action that is clearly observable and verifiable in the Minecraft environment. The agent needs to find a hoe in their inventory (or nearby), locate a dirt block, and use the hoe on it to convert it into farmland. This is a fundamental Minecraft mechanic that doesn't require deep domain knowledge — just the understanding that a hoe is used on dirt to create farmland. The result is visually distinct (dirt texture changes to farmland texture) and can be verified through block state checks. The scene can be set up with a dirt block and a hoe in the player's inventory, making it straightforward yet meaningful as a benchmark task.

milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='farmland') because the task requires converting at least one dirt block into farmland by using a hoe on it. The farmland block will appear in the dirt platform area at y=-1 (one block below spawn). A generous box covering the entire 11x11 dirt platform is used to detect any farmland block created anywhere on the platform. This directly verifies the task outcome — the physical block state change from dirt to farmland.

scene_description: A fenced 11x11 dirt platform with a diamond hoe given to the player, a water source block in one corner for irrigation, torches for lighting, and stone beneath to prevent digging too deep. The player must use the hoe on any dirt block to till it into farmland.
task_text: You have a diamond hoe in your inventory. Use it on a dirt block to till it into farmland.
atomic_tasks_ordered: till dirt into farmland with hoe
design_notes: The player spawns standing on the dirt platform with the diamond hoe already in slot 1 of the hotbar. The 11x11 dirt area provides ample surface for tilling. A water source at (+3, -1, +3) ensures farmland stays hydrated. Oak fence perimeter keeps the player contained and focused. Stone layer beneath prevents accidental mining through. Torches provide visibility. The task requires using (right-click) the hoe on any dirt block — there are ~120 dirt blocks available.
